probe_model_activations_with_AutoProbeD: use AutoProbeD as a context manager to probe and log a PyTorch model's activations, weights, and gradients during forward and backward passes
log_custom_tensor_with_log_stats: use log_stats to log an arbitrary tensor with a custom name into the probe store during model execution
compute_tensor_statistics_with_get_stats: use _get_stats to compute shape, mean, std, skew, kurtosis, min, max, and quantiles for a PyTorch tensor
probe_attention_logits_and_entropy: use AutoProbeD to automatically capture attention logits and entropy statistics from SDPA or xFormers flash attention operations
disable_torch_compile_with_TorchCompileD: use TorchCompileDisabler as a context manager to temporarily disable torch.compile on a module and its submodules
